title: Judeo-Tat - Wikipedia
text: Judeo-Tat or Juhuri is a Judeo-Persian dialect and the traditional language spoken by the Mountain Jews in the eastern Caucasus Mountains, especially Azerbaijan, parts of Russia and today in Israel.

title: Judeo-Tat
text: Judeo-Tat is the native language of the ancient Jewish communities of Mountain Jews in the Daghestan region of the Caucasus. It is written in the Cyrillic alphabet and recently the Hebrew alphabet has been employed as well.
